purpose: Machine-readable bibliography of key mathematical and software references for implementing agents and verification tools.

references.author: Powell, Warren B.
references.title: Reinforcement Learning and Stochastic Optimization: A Unified Framework for Sequential Decisions
references.role_in_mittens: Establishes the canonical 5-element sequential decision analytics (SDA) model (State, Decision, Exogenous Information, Transition, Objective) and the 4 universal classes of policies (PFA, CFA, VFA, DLA). Grounding for Inviolate 1 and Inviolate 7.

references.author: Powell, Warren B.
references.title: Sequential Decision Analytics and Modeling: Modeling with Python
references.role_in_mittens: Guides explicit state modeling and parameter management. Backs Inviolate 0 (no ambient environment variable loading during semantic execution).

references.author: Silver, David and Veness, Joel
references.title: Monte-Carlo Planning in Large POMDPs
references.journal: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NIPS 2010)
references.role_in_mittens: Establishes Partially Observable Monte Carlo Planning (POMCP) and the UCT tree search over histories. Core mathematical backbone for Mittens' Direct Lookahead Approximations (DLAs) in Section 7.4 of the HLD.

references.author: Araya-López, Mauricio and Thomas, Vincent and Buffet, Olivier and Charpillet, François
references.title: A Closer Look at MOMDPs
references.role_in_mittens: Establishes Mixed-Observability Markov Decision Processes (MOMDPs). Provides the mathematical foundation for factoring fully observable physical states (Rt) out of the latent competitive belief space, enforcing Inviolate 2.

references.author: Bernstein, Daniel S. and Givan, Robert and Immerman, Neil and Zilberstein, Shlomo
references.title: The Complexity of Decentralized Control of Markov Decision Processes
references.role_in_mittens: Defines complexity bounds and decentralization. Forms the theoretical ceiling for multi-agent games, justifying our competitor-collapsing simplification and reinforcing Inviolate 3 (competitive-dimension genericity Nc >= 0).

references.author: Powell, Warren B. and Ghadimi, S.
references.title: The Parametric Cost Function Approximation: A new approach for multistage stochastic programming
references.role_in_mittens: Underpins our Cost Function Approximation (CFA) policy structure. Section 7.2 of the HLD leverages this for parameterizing driver allocation and win-rate pricing coefficients under unobserved competitor concentration.

references.author: Ye, Nan and Somani, Aditi and Hsu, David and Lee, Wee Sun
references.title: DESPOT: Online POMDP Planning with Regularization
references.role_in_mittens: Introduces Determinized Sparse Partially Observable Trees (DESPOT). Core reference for executing low-variance lookahead searches by sampling scenarios from our competitive belief state (HLD Section 7.4).

references.author: JuliaPOMDP
references.title: POMDPs.jl: A Framework for Sequential Decision Making under Uncertainty
references.role_in_mittens: The primary API pattern inspiration. Illustrates how to model states, actions, observations, and updaters using decoupled type hierarchies. Serves as the blueprint for our generic Go interfaces (Inviolate 3).

references.author: Tu, Tengfei and Liu, Xiaoran and Song, Linhai and Zhang, Yiying
references.title: Understanding Real-World Concurrency Bugs in Go
references.role_in_mittens: Provides the safety foundation for lock-free goroutine coordination, channel buffer sizing, and timeout contexts, forming the basis of Inviolate 6 and AGENTS.md concurrency patterns.

references.author: Uber Technologies, Inc.
references.title: Uber Go Style Guide
references.role_in_mittens: Establishes quality standards for Go structures. Inviolate 0 specifically references its 'Avoid Init' pattern to eliminate ambient global state modifications.
